title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's rollout, licensing, default state and controls are supported by the supplied records and Microsoft documentation. It accurately distinguishes the Android rollout notice from Learn's preview and future-release wording, and explains the different names for saving access to notes.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android.

claims.claim: Facilitator takes notes in scheduled Teams meetings.
claims.quote: Facilitator is an AI-powered agent in Teams that can automatically take notes of the conversations that happen during a meeting, provide key highlights, and answer prompts in the meeting chat.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes inviting Facilitator with one tap on the room console.
claims.quote: Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console.

claims.where: Scope; Governance controls; Why it matters
claims.claim: Learn's setup includes the room-level Pro Management portal note-taking setting.
claims.quote: Step 4: Turn on note-taking for Teams Rooms

claims.claim: Pro Management portal supports configuring settings for Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones)

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: No API for the Take notes setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Show Take notes API Graph PowerShell Pro Management; Teams Rooms Facilitator Take notes settings API Graph teamwork device configuration XML. Read Rooms Facilitator, portal settings, and XML/troubleshooting excerpts; no operation sets this control.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Meeting transcription is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription through the general Global meeting policy.
claims.quote:
To allow everyone in your organization to transcribe meetings, events, and group calls, except users with an assigned custom meeting policy, run the following command:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: Learn's setup links the general transcription policy without identifying which policy the room account's in-person notes use.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms in-person notes room resource account which meeting policy transcription. Read Rooms setup, transcription policy, Rooms/Copilot and release-note excerpts; none identifies the effective policy for the in-person Facilitator session.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: No admin-center path is documented for the Teams IsLoopEnabled setting.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled admin center. Read Loop admin configuration, including its admin-center, Cloud Policy and Teams sections; Teams IsLoopEnabled is a SharePoint PowerShell property, while the admin-center checkbox controls Loop workspaces.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: SharePoint PowerShell Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled is a tenant-wide SharePoint property controlling Teams Loop component creation and integration.
claims.quote: IsLoopEnabled (boolean) | This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is a tenant-wide SharePoint property for collaborative meeting notes.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled does not apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar

claims.claim: The Facilitator app can be reached in Teams admin center through Teams apps > Manage apps, then selecting Facilitator.
claims.quote:
In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps.
In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator.
Select Facilitator from the app list.

claims.claim: The Facilitator setup page says Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default. However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: Apply Now queues a portal settings job and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply it.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.claim: Schedule Later applies portal settings changes during the nightly maintenance window.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.claim: Learn's Take notes portal setup step itself names no platform, leaving its Android-specific applicability unclear.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Show Take notes API Graph PowerShell Pro Management. Read the Rooms Facilitator setup and FAQ and portal settings: the setting's step names no OS, the FAQ projects Android for a future release, and portal settings gives general Android management.

claims.claim: MC1307888 describes no other Facilitator actions in the room beyond the note-taking outputs discussed.
claims.quote: Searched: read all of supplied MC1307888, including What will happen and Compliance considerations, for agent actions. It describes generating notes, summaries, decisions and action items, displaying and accessing notes, and deleting unclaimed notes, but no additional agent actions.
